title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Monitoring for Global Financial Services
business: A multinational financial services firm managing complex cross-border regulatory obligations.
problem: The legal department struggles with manual tracking of disparate regulatory updates across multiple jurisdictions, leading to delayed compliance responses and increased risk of oversight.
solution: The firm utilizes Harvey's Horizon Scanning to automate the ingestion and assessment of regulatory changes, integrating these insights directly into internal legal workflows via Legal Work Orchestration to ensure timely remediation.
steps: Configure Horizon Scanning to monitor specific regulatory bodies and jurisdictions relevant to the firm's operations.
Define automated alerts within the Command Center to trigger when significant regulatory shifts are detected.
Utilize Legal Work Orchestration to assign identified compliance gaps to specific legal teams for review.
Store and organize supporting documentation within Vault to maintain a clear audit trail of the compliance response.
Collaborate in secure Spaces to finalize and approve the necessary policy adjustments.
outcome: Legal teams achieve a proactive compliance posture, reducing the manual burden of monitoring and ensuring that regulatory changes are addressed systematically rather than reactively.
limitation: The system relies on the quality and scope of the configured monitoring parameters; users must periodically audit the configuration to ensure no new regulatory sources are missed, which can be verified by cross-referencing internal compliance logs against external regulatory bulletins.
